name: Agent Tasks
description: Scheduled bots collect tasks from your other apps into one board in Orca. From it, hand any task to a bot or start it in its project with a coding agent.

cover.alt: Flyer: tasks from chat, email, a tracker, reminders and notes flow via a scheduled bot into one board, then out to a bot or a coding agent. Made-up tasks.

screenshots.alt: The board: a column per status; each card shows its due day, priority, project, checklist and the bot or agent on it.
screenshots.caption: The board, a column per status

screenshots.alt: The list in a dark theme with a task open in the details pane: status, due, priority, project, tags, checklist and notes.
screenshots.caption: A task's details, with its checklist

screenshots.alt: The send form in a task's details: send to the project's bot as a handoff, in its Home Chat, then move the task to In Progress.
screenshots.caption: Send a task to an Orca bot

screenshots.alt: The board in a dark theme.
screenshots.caption: Follows Orca's theme, light and dark
